targets.query: AppExceptions | where DependencyName == 'Cosmos' | summarize c=count() by bin(Timestamp,1m), ExceptionType | order by Timestamp asc
AppSpans | where DependencyName == 'Cosmos' | summarize p95=percentile(DependencyLatencyMs,95) by bin(Timestamp,1m), ServiceName | order by Timestamp asc

AppExceptions | where DependencyName == 'Cosmos' | where ExceptionType has 'NameResolution' or ExceptionMessage has 'invalid-dns' or ExceptionMessage has 'getaddrinfo' or ExceptionMessage has 'Could not resolve' | top 100 by Timestamp desc | project Timestamp, ExceptionType, ExceptionMessage, CorrelationId, TraceId, ServiceName, Pod
AppSpans | where DependencyName == 'Cosmos' and DependencyStatusCode == 200 | summarize ok=count() by bin(Timestamp,5m) | top 1 by Timestamp desc
